name: feature-flags
intro: The 5 feature flags of OpenCTI 7.260811.0-lts.1: features still in development, hidden until `app:enabled_dev_features` lists them (see the [configuration reference](/reference/opencti/configuration/)). Reserved to development and not supported: a flagged feature can change or disappear in any release, so leave flags off in production; the guides describe the platform without them, and a feature is documented when a release removes its flag.
filter: Filter flags, API fields and screens

cells: Adds a **Use** access right between view and edit on restricted entities and organizations, and limits the author and authorized-member pickers to the identities the user can use.
Custom fields, defined in **Settings > Taxonomies > Custom fields** and added to entity types, with their values in entity forms, overviews, filters and playbooks (7.260811; public from 7.261109).
The **Health** screen in **Data > Health**, listing the operations of the data sanity manager (the manager itself runs without the flag).
A background check of the search engine every minute that logs its cluster health, node and thread pool statistics.
A **Logs** tab on TAXII feeds, listing the entries of their ingestion runs.

sections.title: Turn a flag on
sections.text: A flag turns its feature on for the whole platform; no flag is set per user or per organization.

cells: The list of flags to turn on, in the platform configuration file. Read once when the platform starts: restart it after a change. The front reads the same list from the platform settings.
The same list as an environment variable, written as a JSON array.
Turns every flag on, in the back end and the front, including the flags of features not listed here.

sections.title: Flags the platform sets by itself
sections.text: The platform adds these to the flags the front reads, from what it detects itself; listing one in `app:enabled_dev_features` also turns it on in the front, but not in the back end.

cells: Sorting lists on fields computed at query time, turned on by the platform when the search engine is Elasticsearch 7.12 or later. The `*` value of `app:enabled_dev_features` also turns it on in the front.
